steps.text: 11:45 P.M. \ Cloudy
Downtown Lungmen, Cafe Al Fresco

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: A pleasant aroma

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: To enjoy such a lovely al fresco cafe, with a sandwich, by candlelight, as the people go by, with the fragrance of sweet candy,

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: It would be a truly relaxing experience were it not for this young lady staring daggers into me.
...I just happened to be walking by. But that thing you have in your hand isn't the kind of thing that can be explained by happenstance.

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: I have explained. Mostima is acting in her capacity as an employee of Penguin Logistics, and I am helping her guard the staff in her absence.
You think I'm going to let some freak who talks to her staff off the hook?

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: F- freak...? Let's just pretend you didn't see that.

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: She will be fine.
I'm not worried about her.

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: Nor will she make trouble.
...I hope you're right.

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: ...... (Perhaps I should just stay in the hotel.)

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Oh, here you are. What was that back there?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Just a flight of whimsy.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Your whimsy might have been a little too powerful. You knew Penguin Logistics was there, didn't you?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: And as old as you are, you probably shouldn't exert yourself like that. You're not looking to cut it short, are you?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Just how much of my power do you think I expended?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: ...right.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Well how about you take your murderous aura down a notch? I've had just about all the ominous energy I can take.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: So what happened?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: I may have underestimated the vigilance of the youth. Lungmen's young people never fail to impress me.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: It is nothing major, but a few out of control puppets have injured a remarkably dedicated finball master. That is all.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: 'That is all?' I think you need to work on your expressions before you go saying things like that.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: The one who always smiles never truly smiles. Compared to you, I am very relaxed.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Isn't this something you planned for?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Like, in order to prevent this conflict between Penguin Logistics and the mob from turning sour, you went looking for an excuse to punish them? Something like that?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Look at you, girl. It's such a waste to have you scrounging around with that penguin.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I'll take that as a compliment.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: ...But I did not permit them to go trampling the slums. I would never permit that.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: I have reached the end of my patience for their constant oversteps, and yet they still continue to disregard the rules.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: I had assumed that if they maintained even a faint connection to Siracusa, they might be of some miniscule, interesting benefit to Lungmen... I am very disappointed.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Wait a second... why are you telling me all of this? This isn't like a 'reveal your whole plan before killing me to keep your secrets' sort of thing, is it?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Old people need to complain.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Oh yeah? Then I'll just treat it like a Sauin Carnival. I didn't hear a word you just said.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: The more trouble the mafia stirs up, the bigger the balance I'm due on the other side.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: And after you have that money?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: The first thing I'll do is buy that candy shop.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Heh. You really are attached.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Fine. Aside from the cellar, everything else is yours.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: There's a cellar...? Can't you try to protect my sweet memories, even a little bit?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: It's my shop.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: That's too bad. I really thought you'd retire as something more like a grocer.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Maybe. If I'm still alive by the time I retire.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Time grows short. The Carnival is about to begin. The players in this show are already in position.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: You're not watching from the sidelines anymore?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: ...the scenery here is lovely, isn't it?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Sauin is all about honoring the dead. And Lungmen is our city, after all.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: When the living enjoy their lively carousing, only then may the souls of the dead depart without regret.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: And if we have a rat with one foot in a coffin, unless it moves, one might mistake it for a deceased soul ready to depart.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: How are we supposed to do 'lively carousing?'

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Just like this.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Oh... I see.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Then this Sauin's expenses must be pretty high. Wasteful, even.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Smart girl.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Otherwise, Chief Wei would've come after you a long time ago.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Let's not speak of such matters. I certainly don't want to talk to the LGD again. So annoying.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: But the key to a good show is when the actors foot the bill themselves.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: *Pant* *pant* Are those guys mobsters too? How much farther do we have to run?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Definitely not. They might be some of those thugs we ran into before. There's too many of them. Don't want to think about it. Just run. We can lose them.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: But I just saw a guy running at us with a rolling pin...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: That's how these fights usually go. You don't come to the slums often?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Sometimes they end up rolling some blood or teeth into the dough, and then a customer gets all pissed off when he bites into somebody else's tooth.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: I really didn't need such a detailed explanation.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...Have you known Mostima for a long time?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: You're getting pretty friendly with me now.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Mostima said she was testing me...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Oh? I never heard about that.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...I guess I didn't either.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Why do you look up to her so much? It's really different from the way you treat the rest of us.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: She's kind of like... everything I ever hoped to be as a Messenger. She's done everything I ever hoped to do.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...I really envy her.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Even though I don't really get what's going on in her head.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: That's how it goes. I chased her from Laterano to Lungmen, then I met the boss, and all the way up to today, I still don't know what's going on in her head.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I've since given up. It's easier to just wait until she pops up right behind me.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Don't be so gloomy... Wait, did you say from Laterano to Lungmen?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Uh huh. You caught that, did you? Don't give me that look. I'm just as good as Mostima. Maybe she's a little bit ahead, but...

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: No, it really doesn't matter to me. We should focus on meeting up with Texas.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Hrm.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Hm.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Wasn't that a little too hard?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: That's justified self-defense. Don't sweat it.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Hey! Texas~

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: You're okay. But where's Mostima?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Do you really have to ask? She Mostima'd.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Oh. Sorry.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: What are you sorry about? And what are you all looking at me for?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Ahaha... Mostima came back. We'll see her again sooner or later.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: But first, we should probably deal with these new bad guys...

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: So what's this all about?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Some kinda revenge for us bein' too rowdy?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Maybe.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Maybe?! Are the slums always this violent?!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Can't make friends if you don't throw down. Talkin' with yer fists is the oldest form of communication!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Got a call. It's the boss.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: What's crackin'?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: You ladies havin' fun? Feel like you're missing something?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: No? Good. Listen up.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Mr. Emperor... did you happen to buy a lot of insurance?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: There's a big Carnival Gala down on Luk Low Street for Sauin tonight. They got some no-name marketing thing going on.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: But I decided I'm gonna make an appearance there as your big time rap god.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: We'll bring some fire beats to Lungmen. They break down in tears, and bow down all nice and tidy.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: As for you, you're gonna watch my back. Then you scoop up all these wannabes chasin' us in one fell swoop.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Got it? Got it. Good. Make it happen.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: ...He hung up.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Feels like deja vu all over again.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: So I guess we have to go to that party thing too?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Yep. Let's hit the road!
